description_short: Raises a critical in-game alert when a significant share of the train fleet is traffic-blocked.
description_long: Monitors the game's explicit train traffic states. A train counts as stuck after waiting for track clearance for one production cycle; a continuous critical notification appears when at least three and at least ten percent of active trains are stuck. The alert clears automatically when traffic recovers. An opt-in setting can pause the game once when a red alert begins.
